mapper.insert: INSERT INTO duty_shift ( id, operational_period_id, incident_assignment_id, police_phone_id, status, started_by_account_id, ended_by_account_id, started_at, ended_at, version, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{opId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{incidentAssignmentId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{policePhoneId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{status}, #{startedByAccountId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{endedByAccountId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{startedAt}, #{endedAt}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT ds.*, op.incident_id, pp.phone_code AS police_phone_code, pp.display_name AS police_phone_display_name FROM duty_shift ds JOIN operational_period op ON op.id = ds.operational_period_id LEFT JOIN police_phone pp ON pp.id = ds.police_phone_id WHERE ds.id = #{id,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}
mapper.update: UPDATE duty_shift SET status = 'ENDED', ended_by_account_id = #{endedByAccountId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, ended_at = #{endedAt}, version = #{version}, updated_at = #{endedAt} WHERE id = #{id,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
